description: A handy, entry-level pressure washer ideal for domestic use on driveways, patios, bikes, decking, windows or even cleaning drains. An easy to use, lightweight high-pressure washer, with extreme power suitable for a range of applications. Universal Motor: 1.3kW universal electric motor with wobble plate pump powerful enough to get enough the most stubborn dirt out of your stones. Low Noise: Noise minimised by sound absorption sponges inside the housing along with a vibration isolation structure incorporated in the design of the pump. High-Pressure Hose: High quality 3 mtr hose provides more convenience for a range of applications. Total Stop System: TSS switches the motor ON and OFF when the lance trigger is operated which increases the motor life. Lightweight: Lightweight enough to be moved around with ease and used on any number of different jobs, such as cleaning driveways and vehicles of all type. Accessories: Supplied with Trigger Gun, Vario Spray Lance, High-Pressure Hose, Detergent Bottle and Water Coupling Kit.
